content: tell me about database indexing strategies
B-trees support range queries while hash indexes are O(1) for equality.
when would you use a composite index
When queries filter on multiple columns together.
Partial indexes only index rows matching a condition.
A covering index includes all columns needed by the query.
what is index bloat and how to address it
Index bloat occurs when dead tuples accumulate; VACUUM helps.
explain the difference between clustered and non-clustered indexes
Clustered indexes determine physical row order.
Write-heavy tables suffer from too many indexes.
